description: This file provides helper functions for interacting with Google Places and Directions APIs, including fetching place details, computing directions summaries, and providing safety tips. It uses environment variables for configuration and includes simulated responses for testing or fallback scenarios.

methods.name: getGooglePlaceDetailsByText(query)
methods.description: Fetches details about a place using a text query, either by calling Google Places API or returning a simulated response based on environment variables.

methods.name: getGoogleDirectionsSummary(points, mode)
methods.description: Calculates a summary of directions between multiple points, either via Google Directions API or a simulated response, returning distance and duration.

methods.name: travelSafetyTip(mode)
methods.description: Provides safety tips based on the mode of transportation (car, bike, walking).
